verses.restored: I will sing of mercy and judgment: to thee, O YHWH, will I sing.

familiar.text: I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.

modern.text: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.

original.text: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר חֶֽסֶד וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֲזַמֵּֽרָה

verses.restored: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come to me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

familiar.text: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

modern.text: I will ponder the way that is blameless— when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.

original.text: אַשְׂכִּ֤ילָה בְּדֶ֬רֶךְ תָּמִ֗ים מָ֭תַי תָּב֣וֹא אֵלָ֑י אֶתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתָם לְ֝בָבִ֗י בְּקֶ֣רֶב בֵּיתִֽי

verses.restored: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

familiar.text: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

modern.text: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.

original.text: לֹֽא אָשִׁ֨ית לְנֶ֥גֶד עֵינַ֗י דְּֽבַר בְּלִ֫יָּ֥עַל עֲשֹֽׂה סֵטִ֥ים שָׂנֵ֑אתִי לֹ֖א יִדְבַּ֣ק בִּֽי

verses.restored: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

familiar.text: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

modern.text: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.

original.text: לֵבָ֣ב עִ֭קֵּשׁ יָס֣וּר מִמֶּ֑נִּי רָ֝֗ע לֹ֣א אֵדָֽע

verses.restored: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

familiar.text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

modern.text: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.

original.text: מלושני בַסֵּ֨תֶר רֵעֵהוּ֮ אוֹת֪וֹ אַ֫צְמִ֥ית גְּֽבַהּ עֵ֭ינַיִם וּרְחַ֣ב לֵבָ֑ב אֹ֝ת֗וֹ לֹ֣א אוּכָֽל

verses.restored: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

familiar.text: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

modern.text: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.

original.text: עֵינַ֤י בְּנֶֽאֶמְנֵי אֶרֶץ֮ לָשֶׁ֪בֶת עִמָּ֫דִ֥י הֹ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ תָּמִ֑ים ה֝֗וּא יְשָׁרְתֵֽנִי

verses.restored: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

familiar.text: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

modern.text: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.

verses.restored: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of YHWH.

familiar.text: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.

modern.text: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
